title: Verification Config
description: Configuration for Docker-based fix verification. The image is pre-built — pulled directly, no in-container install.

branch_or_ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA containing the fix

expected_behavior.description: What the test output should contain when passing. Can be literal string or /regex/ pattern.

docker_image.description: Pre-built Docker image to pull. For SGLang defaults to lmsysorg/sglang:latest — all dependencies included.

build_command.description: Test command only — no install steps. The image already has all dependencies.

failure_log.description: The original failure log (from before the fix). Used to confirm the old error is gone.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum runtime for the container before it is killed

gpu_required.description: Whether the test requires GPU/NPU access

env_vars.description: Additional environment variables to pass to the container

ecosystem.description: Auto-detected ecosystem. 'sglang' triggers SGLang test framework + lmsysorg/sglang:latest image.

sglang_repo_path.description: SGLang repo root on host (auto-detected via git rev-parse --show-toplevel). Used as Docker -v mount source.

test_framework.description: Specific test framework (auto-detected). For SGLang: pytest with test_utils.py integration.

workspace_dir.description: Absolute path to the workspace directory for outputs

resolved_docker_command.description: The final docker pull + docker run command (filled by Step 1)
